verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents its text APIs as OpenAI-compatible, has a "Migrate from OpenAI" path billed as a drop-in replacement with the same API, and tells developers to point their client at api.fireworks.ai. Tool calling also follows OpenAI-compatible specifications. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party OpenAI SDK snippet showing that only the base_url and api_key change, documentation of any required model-ID changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility.
